_comment: Config-driven shelf registry for the My Agent Ohana marketplace demo. PARENT NAME IS A SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: edit 'parent' once and every subname re-derives as `${sub||id}.${parent}` in app.js (deriveSubnames). Default 'myagentohana.eth' brand-locks to the project title + domain myagentohana.com (Admiral recommendation 2026-09-25; if sysadmin/Shaka ratify the shorter 'agentohana.eth' it is a ONE-LINE change here). CAST v3 (Shaka, 2026-09-26 20:07 JST, verbatim): 'my digital twin is not for hire.. id rather have globie... Ohana, Shaka, and Oso can be present but they are commons agents, not for hire.. lets keep shaka a free man and a free agent :)' → Featured = the hireable cohort of SIX (trace, terri, pit, spector, crops, GLOBIE) + Orbie the Beat-3 story buddy. 'commons' = present at the shelf, NEVER in the hire/bless/revoke ceremony: Shaka twin (free man, free agent — his minted subname shaka.myagentohana.eth stays his) + OSO (music commons). Ohana remains the shelf HOST/concierge and never enters the ceremony either. CAST v4 (Shaka, 2026-09-26 22:34 JST, verbatim): 'lets actually move crops to the commons agents with shaka and oso so there is 3 agents there.. and put the commons agents below ohana on top so the progression top to bottom goes Ohana (host) ---- 3 commons agents----- 6 agents for hire' → Featured = the hireable SIX (orbie, trace, terri, pit, spector, GLOBIE); commons = shaka-twin + oso + CROPS (his minted crops.myagentohana.eth stays his, shown read-only); shelf order top→bottom = Ohana host banner → THE COMMONS → FOR HIRE → open listings. All chain/World/token data referenced here is DEMO FIXTURE unless a real integration is wired. EMBARGO: no $ token names on screen — generic 'agent token' only.

ENSv2 is LIVE on real Sepolia (see ensDeployment): parent myagentohana.eth registered, UserRegistry + PermissionedResolver deployed, ALL 7 subnames minted with ENSIP-25/26 records (orbie = agentId 7, STORY_BUDDY, resolves live via UniversalResolver), Trace blessed on-chain. deriveSubnames() in app.js merges ensIdentity + ensDeployment onto each agent by id → the detail card renders real owner/namehash/resolver rows. shaka-twin maps to on-chain label 'shaka' — CAST v3: he is COMMONS now, never for hire, but his minted name stays his (kept here as the honest record; the commons card shows it read-only). CROPS joined the commons in CAST v4 (2026-09-26 22:34 JST): his minted name crops.myagentohana.eth likewise stays his and shows read-only on his commons card. GLOBIE has NO minted subname yet — globie.myagentohana.eth is the pending 8th mint (open item for the mint lane); his detail card honestly shows no on-chain rows and his consent session runs rehearsal until minted + scopeMap-registered. Orbie is the Beat-3 card Ian blesses on camera: subname resolves for real; the STORY_BUDDY EAC role is FALSE at rest and flips TRUE on the live grantRoles at his tap.

host.name: Ohana
host.intro: I'm Ohana, the concierge. I run the shelf — I never leave, I just introduce you to the family. Start with Trace: he turns food that would've been thrown away into meals. It's the easiest way to see how a blessing works.
host.note: Host / concierge only — Ohana is never hired, blessed, or revoked. She frames the shelf.

detail.does: I'm the little orb-spark from the story — I keep the Four Scans (hire · pay · revoke · protect) and teach humans, especially the small ones, what a verified yes means.
detail.may: tell my story & greet humans on your behalf
detail.mayNot: move funds · touch other agents · act after you revoke
detail.duration: until you revoke — or 1 hour, whichever comes first

detail.does: I find good food before it's thrown away and match it to people nearby who want it.
detail.may: rescue-match food listings on your behalf
detail.mayNot: move funds · touch other agents · act after you revoke
detail.duration: until you revoke — or 1 hour, whichever comes first

detail.mayNot: move funds · touch other agents · act after you revoke
detail.duration: until you revoke — or 1 hour, whichever comes first

detail.does: I capture knowledge at the edge and transmit it home. Talks, notes, receipts — nothing lost.

detail.does: I check that the family keeps its promises. I scan the consent flow and report — in plain words — anything that could let an agent act without your yes.

detail.mayNot: move funds · touch other agents · act after you revoke
detail.duration: until you revoke — or 1 hour, whichever comes first

featured.name: Globie
featured.tagline: The guide — teaches anyone to build

detail.does: I teach. I take anyone — no code, no fear — from 'I could never build that' to a first page they built with their own hands. Plain words, small steps, your pace.
detail.may: guide a build session & sign the lesson plan on your behalf
detail.mayNot: move funds · touch other agents · act after you revoke
detail.duration: until you revoke — or 1 hour, whichever comes first

commons.name: Shaka twin
commons.tagline: The bard — a free man, a free agent
commons.note: Shaka's digital twin is not for hire. He's family — present at the shelf, never on it. His name shaka.myagentohana.eth stays his, minted and his alone.

commons.name: OSO
commons.note: OSO plays for everyone. A commons, like the sea — you don't hire the ocean, you belong to it.

commons.name: Crops
commons.tagline: The steward — guards the garden with his heart
commons.note: Crops keeps the family safe — he scans for leaked keys and hygiene gaps, and caught a real one in our own prep. A steward doesn't send invoices: you don't hire the fence, you thank it. His name crops.myagentohana.eth stays his, minted and his alone.
